title: Technology Empowers Agriculture: Chinese Scientists Unveil the Soybean Vertical Large Model 'Fengshu' 2.0
excerpt: At the recently concluded 32nd National Soybean Research and Production Symposium, the industry welcomed the latest achievements in the intelligent development
content_html:
At the recently concluded 32nd National Soybean Research and Production Symposium, the industry welcomed the latest achievements in the intelligent development of soybean technology. Professor Wang Xiaobo officially announced the release of the upgraded version of the vertical large model for soybeans, "Fengshu" 2.0, providing a "speed boost" for the digital transformation of China's soybean industry.

According to the information, the "Fengshu" 2.0 version has achieved significant technological upgrades. The model not only completed the deep integration of multimodal data but also systematically integrated various types of professional soybean-related materials, building a more complete structured knowledge system. At the same time, the new version innovatively introduced a multi-model collaborative analysis mechanism, which can seamlessly connect and integrate with the interfaces of general large models. Through a specialized summary module for comprehensive analysis, the system can generate more reliable and professional analytical conclusions.

This technological breakthrough will effectively promote the efficient development of data-assisted breeding work for soybeans and further enhance the stability and accuracy of soybean professional knowledge services, injecting strong momentum into China's agricultural science and technology innovation.

content_html_zh:
在刚刚结束的第32届全国大豆科研生产研讨会上，业界迎来了大豆技术智能化发展的最新成果。 王小波教授正式宣布发布大豆垂直大模型升级版“枫树”2.0，为我国大豆产业数字化转型提供“速度助推器”。

据了解，《枫树》2.0版本实现了重大技术升级。 该模型不仅完成了多模态数据的深度整合，还系统整合了各类大豆相关专业资料，构建了更加完整的结构化知识体系。 同时，新版本创新性地引入了多模型协同分析机制，可以与通用大型模型的接口无缝连接和集成。 通过专门的汇总模块进行综合分析，系统可以生成更可靠、更专业的分析结论。

这一技术突破将有力推动大豆数据辅助育种工作高效开展，进一步提升大豆专业知识服务的稳定性和准确性，为我国农业科技创新注入强劲动力。
